articles.description: Kwanza Jones and José E. Feliciano want the Padres to be winners. Actually making the team better remains a challenge.
articles.title: Padres’ owners still ‘all in’ after missing on Tarik Skubal. What that means is unclear

articles.description: The Padres’ pursuit of Skubal serves as the first major test of new owners José E. Feliciano and Kwanza Jones.
articles.title: The Padres are expected to meet with Tarik Skubal. How serious are the team’s new owners?
